title: Implement Hash Diff Functions Across All Languages
description: Implement deterministic SHA-256 Merkle hash functions for all diff types across TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, and C#. All languages must produce the same canonical hash d9ee3052111fec2e0fe08119eee6b8d5b6f5578a940f6d5c6bb1806e6e0f36a5 for KitDiff({name: "updated", description: null}). TS and Go are done, need Python, Rust, and C#.
summary: Added `deserialize_some` helper function and annotated all `Option<Option<T>>` fields across 22 diff structs with `#[serde(default, deserialize_with = "deserialize_some", ...)]` to properly distinguish JSON null (Some(None)) from absent fields (None). Used `std::result::Result` in the helper signature to avoid conflict with the crate's custom `Result` type alias. Compilation and canonical hash test pass.
